original_test_intent: Exercise the approved PCIe data path continuously and demonstrate sustained bidirectional or specified-direction bandwidth, stable negotiated link state and platform health for the defined duration under the project performance specification.
original_method: Select by row/variant; map every traffic endpoint and intervening root port, switch or retimer; identify whether the intended transfer is host-to-device, device-to-host, peer-to-peer, RDMA or storage traffic; baseline negotiated generation/width and error/thermal/power state; run only the owner-supplied workload with fixed direction, payload, queue/concurrency, affinity, warm-up and 60-minute measurement window; collect interval throughput plus health telemetry; stop safely on instability and preserve all evidence.
manual_activity: The owner supplies the approved bandwidth tool, endpoint/path map, workload geometry, limits and acceptance thresholds and authorizes the sustained load; an operator remains available for monitoring and recovery.
required_inputs: Unique identity resolution for the duplicate code
PCIe endpoint UUID/serial/BDF, root-port/switch/retimer path, negotiated generation/width, NUMA placement, driver and firmware map
Approved bandwidth tool/module, version/hash/license and exact command semantics
Transfer direction, payload/block size, queue depth, concurrency, affinity, warm-up, measurement duration and repetitions
Theoretical and project bandwidth thresholds, allowed variance, error/retrain/thermal/power limits and recovery plan
safety_requirements: Use a dedicated maintenance window and verify no production workload shares the measured endpoints or path
Preserve existing logs; establish timestamped baselines without clearing dmesg, journal or SEL
Confirm every endpoint and traffic direction; perftest is not evidence of generic PCIe bandwidth unless its RDMA path is the intended coverage
Monitor interval throughput, link state, AER/device errors, temperatures, power and throttling throughout the 60-minute run
Abort on device disappearance, link downgrade/retrain, AER/XID/driver fault, hang, thermal/power limit or performance collapse; do not automatically retry
agent_execution_scope: Validate composite identity, tool provenance, endpoint/path topology, workload parameters and approval
Collect read-only PCIe, NUMA, driver/firmware, log and telemetry baselines
Run only the exact approved command after a separate execution confirmation and collect raw interval evidence
Do not choose a tool, infer SPEC, clear logs, change link settings, power-cycle, retry a failed stress run or decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED
engineer_actions: Resolve the duplicate-code identity while preserving the bandwidth and AC-cycle rows
Approve the exact traffic path, workload/tool and performance/health oracle
Review the raw evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The prose describes the general stress objective but is not executable. `perftest` normally measures an RDMA transport and `pciebw` is not a uniquely identified tool; neither may be assumed to exercise this row's intended PCIe path.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only the project-approved tool and exact endpoint/path-specific command with approved direction, payload, concurrency, affinity, warm-up and 60-minute measurement window; no command can be finalized from the current TBD source.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The 60-minute source duration, bandwidth-stress intent and comparison to project SPEC are preserved; missing load geometry and measurable thresholds remain pending.

modernized_recommendation.status: HIGH RISK PCIe BANDWIDTH_STRESS WITH PACKAGE_AND_APPROVAL_GATE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Measure time-series bandwidth on the explicitly mapped PCIe path while simultaneously recording negotiated link, error, thermal and power state, then compare only with an approved path-specific oracle.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Turns TBD into a bounded prerequisite and evidence contract without inventing the test utility or pass threshold.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A one-shot throughput value, RDMA network result on an unrelated path or AC-cycle link check cannot prove sustained PCIe bandwidth coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Throughput depends on endpoint engines, memory/NUMA placement, protocol overhead and topology; theoretical lane rate is not by itself a valid application-bandwidth threshold.

project_override_considerations: Engineering must specify whether this case targets GPU, NIC, NVMe or another endpoint and whether the oracle is unidirectional, bidirectional, aggregate or per-link. The shared code must remain distinct from row 2209 AC cycling.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and separation from row 2209 AC Cycle - Speed&Link
Tool/module identity, version/hash/license and complete approved command/recipe
Endpoint UUID/serial/BDF and root-port/switch/retimer/NUMA topology with pre/post generation and width
Raw interval throughput, direction, payload, concurrency, warm-up and full 60-minute measurement timestamps
Concurrent AER/device/driver/OS/BMC, temperature, power and throttling telemetry with exit status
Abort/recovery record, comparison to the approved performance and health oracle, and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Wistron-HW-00487-V002 identifies both row 2207 BW stress test and row 2209 AC Cycle - Speed&Link. Row/variant resolves selection, but code-only dispatch could replace sustained traffic and throughput evidence with unrelated power-cycle/link-training evidence.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The bandwidth-stress intent is identifiable. The missing tool, topology, workload geometry and acceptance criteria are normal project inputs that can be supplied; execution remains gated but static review can complete.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2207 Wistron-HW-00487-V002: assign/approve a unique identity distinct from row 2209 AC Cycle - Speed&Link; approve the target endpoint UUID/serial/BDF and complete root-port/switch/retimer/NUMA path, transfer direction and traffic semantics, tool/module version/hash/license and exact command, payload/block size, queue/concurrency, affinity, warm-up, 60-minute measurement/repetition plan, theoretical/project bandwidth and variance oracle, AER/retrain/error/thermal/power abort limits, maintenance isolation and recovery.

review_improvement: Prevents code-collision and generic-tool substitution, preserves the 60-minute stress intent and makes bandwidth, link health, telemetry and recovery evidence auditable without fabricating a command or threshold.
independent_technical_reasoning: A bandwidth test is defined by the traffic producer/consumer and the path it traverses, not by the word PCIe. RDMA perftest can be limited by network and memory subsystems, while a vendor pciebw utility may exercise a different DMA engine; therefore the target, direction and topology must precede tool selection. Sustained throughput must be time-series evidence correlated with negotiated link, AER and thermal/power state because a high average can hide retraining, throttling or intermittent faults. The source's TBD procedure/criteria makes engineering input mandatory but does not erase the identifiable stress objective.
